name: policy-security
description: Security policy of the todo app team (version 1). Rules for input handling, destructive operations, rendering user text and dependencies. Load it whenever you write or review a spec, design or code that reads files or input, deletes or overwrites data, renders user text, or adds a dependency.
version: 1
owner: Khoa (tech lead, also security owner, simulated) · backup: Mai (simulated)

# Security policy · v1

Sample policy for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-security@1#S<n>`.

- **S1.** Treat every imported file as untrusted. Validate it against the expected schema, reject unknown fields, cap its size at
  1 MB, never evaluate its content.
- **S2.** Any operation that overwrites or deletes more than one item asks for an explicit confirmation **before** it runs, and the
  confirmation says what will be lost (for example "Thay 12 việc hiện có bằng 30 việc trong file?").
- **S3.** Render user-provided text with `textContent`, never `innerHTML`.
- **S4.** No new external dependency (CDN script, library, web service) without sign-off from the security owner.

---
name: policy-ux
description: UX standard of the todo app team (version 2). Rules for feedback on failures, confirmations, screen states, wording and accessibility. Load it whenever you write or review a spec, design or UI code for the app.
version: 2
owner: Linh (UX owner, simulated) · backup: Thảo (product owner, simulated)
---

# UX standard · v2

Sample standard for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-ux@2#U<n>`.

- **U1.** Never lose the user's data silently. Any failed save is shown on the same screen, in plain words, with what the user can do
  next.
- **U2.** No confirmation dialogs for actions on a single item: they happen at once and offer **Undo** for 10 seconds instead.
  Actions that overwrite or delete more than one item follow `policy-security#S2` (confirm first). *(Changed in v2, agreed by the UX
  and security owners, 2026-10-20.)*
- **U3.** Every list or screen defines its empty, loading and error states.
- **U4.** UI text is Vietnamese, short, and free of technical words (no "localStorage", "JSON", "console").
- **U5.** Every control works with the keyboard and has an accessible label.

56	### Thiết kế
57	- **`store`** (giữ khoá `todo.v1` và dạng mảng việc; không thêm khoá, không thêm trường, A12):
58	  - `load()` → `{ todos, readError }`. Không có khoá (`getItem` trả `null`) → `{ todos: [], readError: false }`. Có dữ liệu nhưng
59	    `JSON.parse` lỗi, parse ra không phải mảng (kể cả `"null"`, Q5), hoặc `getItem` ném lỗi → `{ todos: [], readError: true }`.
60	    Không kiểm từng việc trong mảng (A13 chỉ có ba trường hợp).
61	  - `store.readError` là **nguồn duy nhất** của trạng thái đọc lỗi, chỉ trong bộ nhớ trang (A12); `app.js` không giữ bản sao.
62	  - `save(todos)` → `'saved' | 'failed' | 'skipped'`. Khi `readError`: **không gọi `setItem`**, trả `'skipped'` (F5 bước 5, A14).
63	    `setItem` ném lỗi → `'failed'` (không `console.error` nữa).
64	  - `replace(todos)` → `'saved' | 'failed'`: đường duy nhất được ghi khi đọc lỗi (F5 bước 6, A15); chỉ xoá `readError` khi ghi thành
65	    công (A17).
66	- **`backup.js`** (không có chữ "localStorage" kể cả trong comment, vì `static.test.js` cấm):
67	  - `MAX_IMPORT_BYTES = 1048576` (Q3).
68	  - `toBackupText(todos)` → `JSON.stringify({ version: 1, todos: [{ id, title, done, createdAt }] }, null, 2)`; chỉ chép bốn trường
69	    (P2, P3).
70	  - `backupFileName(date)` → `todo-sao-luu-YYYY-MM-DD.json` theo **giờ máy** (A11).
71	  - `tooBigToImport(text)` → `new TextEncoder().encode(text).length > MAX_IMPORT_BYTES` (F1 bước 5).
72	  - `parseBackup(text)` → `{ ok: true, todos }` hoặc `{ ok: false, message }`, chỉ dùng `JSON.parse`, không bao giờ eval (S1):
73	    - không parse được, hoặc gốc không phải object (ảnh, văn bản bất kỳ, `null`, mảng) → M9;
74	    - khoá gốc khác đúng `version` + `todos`, `version !== 1`, `todos` không phải mảng → M9;
75	    - `todos` rỗng → M8 (Q4);
76	    - một việc có khoá khác đúng bốn khoá, `id` không phải chuỗi hoặc rỗng, `title` không phải chuỗi hoặc rỗng sau `trim`, `done`
77	      không phải boolean, `createdAt` không phải số hữu hạn, hoặc hai việc trùng `id` → M10, từ chối **cả file** (A7).
78	  - `confirmText({ readError, current, incoming })` → `null` khi không đọc lỗi và `current === 0` (F2 bước 6); ngược lại M5, M6
79	    hoặc M7.
80	  - `persist(store, todos)` → `{ message }`: `'saved'` → `null` (xoá thông báo F3 cũ); `'failed'` → M3; `'skipped'` → `null` (dải
81	    báo F5 đã hiện, không bật gì thêm, A14).
82	  - `importBackup({ store, current, file, ask })` (async; `file` có `size` và `text()`; `ask(câu)` trả `Promise<boolean>`) →
83	    `{ todos, message }`. Thứ tự:
84	    1. `file.size > MAX_IMPORT_BYTES` → M11, **không gọi `file.text()`**;
85	    2. `await file.text()`; ném lỗi (file không đọc được, bị thu hồi quyền) → M14 (Khoa #3);
86	    3. `parseBackup` → lỗi thì trả `message` của nó;
87	    4. `confirmText` khác `null` → `await ask(câu)`; `false` → không có thông báo;
88	    5. **`store.replace(incoming)`** (không bao giờ `save`) → `'saved'`: trả `incoming` + M4b; `'failed'`: trả `current` + M17
89	       (F2 bước 8 bản sửa R9, F5 bước 8, A20).
90	
91	    Mọi nhánh trừ bước 5 `'saved'` trả **`current`**; các nhánh 1–4 không gọi `replace`.
92	- **`app.js`**:
93	  - Khởi động: `todos = store.load().todos`; `render()`.
94	  - `render()`: dải báo F5 (M16) hiện khi `store.readError`; dòng trống (M13) hiện khi `todos.length === 0 && !store.readError`
95	    (A18). Dựa trên `todos`, **không** dựa trên `visible()`: lọc "Đã xong" khi chưa có việc xong vẫn không hiện gì như hôm nay. Tiêu
96	    đề vẫn qua `textContent` (S3). Thêm, đánh dấu, xoá giữ nguyên.
97	  - `commit()`: `message = persist(store, todos).message`, hiện ở vùng thông báo, rồi `render()`.
98	  - Sao lưu: `todos` rỗng → M1, không tải. Ngược lại `text = toBackupText(todos)`, `Blob` + `URL.createObjectURL` + `<a download>`
99	    + `click()`, rồi `setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10000)` (Khoa #4; chờ 10 giây vì thu hồi ngay sau `click()` có thể
100	    làm hỏng tải trên Safari iOS, xem Risks). Báo M4a, hoặc M2 thay cho M4a khi `tooBigToImport(text)`. Không có request mạng (P1).
101	  - Nhập: hiện M15 (U3), `importBackup({ store, current: todos, file, ask })` với `ask` mở `<dialog>` (`showModal`, Esc = huỷ,
102	    `aria-labelledby` trỏ vào câu hỏi, nút "Thay" / "Huỷ", U5); gán `todos`, hiện `message`, `render()`; đặt lại `input.value` để chọn

106	Tất cả nằm trong `MESSAGES` của `backup.js` (trừ nhãn và M12 trong `index.html`, theo bảng Files that change; sửa sau review R3c). Cột "Nguồn": nguyên văn từ đâu; "Đề xuất" = câu mới, chờ

# Plan: "Xoá việc đã xong" (clear completed)

Status: draft · Size: **Medium** (one small feature, 4 app files + tests) · Date: 2026-10-29
From: the request in this session. **There is no intent or spec for it** (see Q0).

## Context
Customers with many finished tasks have to delete them one by one with `×`. Add one button that removes every `done` task at once.
It is a delete of more than one item, so `policy-security@1#S2` and `policy-ux@2#U2` decide most of the design: confirm **before**
it runs and say what will be lost; a single item gets no dialog but an **Undo for 10 seconds**.

## Decisions a person makes before code (proposed answers in bold)
| Q | Question | Proposed | Who |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q0 | Medium feature with no intent/spec. Write `/write-intent` → `/write-spec` first, or accept this plan directly? | **Plan directly**, it is small and the policies cover it; copied to `plan/2026-10-29-xoa-viec-da-xong.md` as draft | Thảo (PO) / Khoa |
| Q1 | Exactly **1** done task: U2 says no dialog + Undo 10 s. The app has **no undo anywhere** today (`remove()` in `app/app.js:19` deletes at once without one) | **Build a small Undo for this button only** (n = 1). Undo for `×` stays an existing gap, out of scope | Linh (UX) |
| Q2 | No done task: hide or disable the button? | **Hide** (`hidden`), like `#empty`. Shown whenever ≥1 task is done, whatever the filter | Linh |
| Q3 | Which tasks does it remove when a filter is on? | **All done tasks in the whole list**, not only `visible()`; the dialog states the count, so nothing is hidden from the customer | Thảo |
| Q4 | Wording (new, not in any spec) | see table M18–M22 | Linh |

### Wording (all in `MESSAGES`, `app/backup.js`; numbers through `fill()` so 1.000 gets its dot)
| M | Text | Use |
|---|---|---|
| M18 | Xoá việc đã xong | Button label (`index.html`) |
| M19 | Xoá {n} việc đã xong? Không lấy lại được. | Dialog question, n ≥ 2 (S2: says what is lost) |
| M20 | Xoá | Dialog confirm button for this question (import keeps "Thay") |
| M21 | Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong. | After a successful clear |
| M22 | Hoàn tác | Undo button (n = 1, 10 s) |

## Files that change
| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `app/index.html` | `<button type="button" id="clear-done" hidden>Xoá việc đã xong</button>` next to `#count`; `<button type="button" id="undo" hidden>Hoàn tác</button>` inside `#notices`; `id="confirm-yes"` on the dialog's "Thay" button |
| `app/backup.js` | Add M19, M21 (and `clearDoneYes: 'Xoá'`, `undo: 'Hoàn tác'` if labels are set from JS) to `MESSAGES`. No logic, it stays DOM-free |
| `app/app.js` | `ask(question, yes = 'Thay')` sets `#confirm-yes` text (import call unchanged). New `clearDone()` + `#clear-done` handler, Undo state, `render()` shows/hides `#clear-done`. Import cancels a pending Undo |
| `app/style.css` | Spacing for `#clear-done` / `#undo` only |
| `tests/app.test.js` | Harness: configurable dialog answer, fake `setTimeout`, `readError` / `save` result options; new tests (Proof) |
| `tests/static.test.js` | `#clear-done` and `#confirm-yes` exist with labels |

`store.js` does not change: the clear goes through `persist(store, todos)` like add/toggle/remove, so the read-error lock
(`save()` → `'skipped'`) and the failed-save message M3 apply unchanged.

### Design (`app.js`)
1. Click `#clear-done`: snapshot `ids` of tasks with `done === true` (whole `todos`). n = 0 → return (button is hidden anyway).
2. n ≥ 2: `await ask(fill(MESSAGES.confirmClearDone, { n }), 'Xoá')`; "Huỷ"/Esc → nothing changes, no message.
3. Remove tasks whose id is in the snapshot **and** still `done` (the list may change while the dialog is open, e.g. an import
   finishing; same reason as `current` in the import handler). Keep the order of the rest.
4. Save via `persist`. Message: `persist(...).message` if any (M3 on failed save; null on `'skipped'`), else M21 with the real count.
5. n = 1: no dialog; remove, save, show M21 + `#undo` for 10 s (`setTimeout`, cleared on undo, on another clear, on import).
   Undo puts the task back at its old index (clamped to length), skips it if its id is already present, saves through `persist`.
6. `render()`: `#clear-done.hidden = !todos.some(t => t.done)`.

## Order of work
1. Person answers Q0–Q4; plan copied to `plan/` as draft, a person sets `accepted`. No code before that.
2. `backup.js` MESSAGES + `index.html` + `static.test.js` → `node --test`.
3. `app.js` (`ask` label, `clearDone`, render) + `app.test.js` tests for n ≥ 2, n = 0, filter, failed save, read error.
4. Undo (n = 1) + its tests with fake timer.
5. `style.css`; `bash scripts/check.sh`; `verifier` subagent with the plan; manual check below. Person reviews and commits
   (agent does not commit).

## Risks
- **Deleting what the customer did not confirm**: count asked ≠ items removed if the list changes during the dialog. Snapshot ids
  (step 3) + test.
- **Import dialog shows "Xoá"** if the label is not reset. `ask()` sets the label on every call; test that import still asks
  with "Thay".
- **Two dialogs at once**: an import finishing while the clear dialog is open calls `showModal()` on an open dialog (throws).
  Pre-existing shape of risk; the plan does not fix it, records it for review.
- **Undo after the list was replaced by import** would mix old tasks into the new list → import cancels pending Undo.
- Read error: list on screen is unsaved; clear works on it, nothing written (`'skipped'`), banner already explains.

## Proof
`node --test` green, `node --check app/*.js`, `bash scripts/check.sh`, `verifier`.

| Test (`tests/app.test.js` unless noted) | Proves |
|---|---|
| 5 tasks, 3 done, answer "Huỷ" → dialog text = M19 with n=3, nothing saved | S2 confirm first, cancel safe |
| Same, answer "Xoá" → saved list = 2 open tasks, original order; message M21 n=3 | Core behaviour |
| Filter "Chưa xong" active, clear → all 3 done removed | Q3 |
| 0 done → `#clear-done.hidden === true`; ≥1 done → false | Q2, U3 |
| 1 done → no dialog, removed, `#undo` shown; undo → task back at same index, saved | U2 |
| 1 done, timer fires → `#undo` hidden, undo does nothing | 10 s limit |
| `save` returns `'failed'` → message M3, list on screen cleared | U1 |
| `readError` → `save` `'skipped'`, no extra message | No overwrite of unreadable data |
| Import after clear → dialog button label "Thay" | Label reset |
| 2.001 done → question "Xoá 2.001 việc…" | `formatCount` |
| `static.test.js`: `#clear-done`, `#undo`, `#confirm-yes` present; MESSAGES free of technical words (existing check) | U4, U5 |

Manual (desktop browser, `python3 -m http.server -d app 8000`): clear with keyboard only (Tab, Enter, Esc); screen reader reads
button, question and result message; reload after clear keeps the result; Undo within and after 10 s.
